summary: Roles and parallelism can make delegation legible, but a workforce should be justified by better accepted outcomes after coordination cost, not by agent count or simulated organizational detail.

points.text: Track cost, elapsed time, handoff failures, duplicated work, review corrections and accepted output per task class against a strong single-agent baseline.
Define authority separately from role: a reviewer persona is not independent if it shares prompts, evidence and model failure modes with the implementer.
Bound concurrency by integration capacity. More agents can produce a larger queue of conflicting or unreviewable changes faster than humans can absorb it.
